Every engineer said it couldn't be done. Henry Ford wanted it anyway.

Kevin explains how the brilliant engineers called the V8 engine impossible, because on paper the mechanics and ratios didn't work.

Henry Ford said he didn't know much about engineering, but he knew he wanted that engine. He gave the team six weeks to deliver it, and Kevin says the result transformed the automotive industry.

Which of your "facts" would you test if you kept your eye on what you want?

#ad #success #mindset #kevintrudeau

One question, asked every day, changed how Kevin worked.

Kevin explains that he kept asking himself whether his attitude was right today. He repeated it again and again, and says he was determined to reach the goal no matter how many obstacles showed up.

As he worked on his attitude, he says the facts that told him it couldn't be done began to fall away. His takeaway is that the universe will yield and bend to your will.

What would change if you asked yourself that question every morning?
